_about: Tide-line nodes (WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md part 2; Tyler 31 Oct 2026). ACT_GATHER_EDGE on a beach cell next to the sea: the cell (cell_m square) holds a node with chance node_chance, chosen from the cell and the game day (so the same every time that day); the kind is picked by weight. A node is used up until the next game day. only_hours = [from, to) game hours the node is there; only_seasons = the seasons. Sea water: a bucket, clay jug or waterskin in the pack and the sea within reach gives one sea_water.
